description: Asks Luxor's designers to create a free, realistic mockup image and short video of the user's plastic business card and email it to them within 1-2 business days. No payment or obligation. Works with just a description: include the business/profession, style and colors in description and the exact card text in card_text. Optional artwork_urls are public HTTPS links to a logo or design. Only call this after the user has asked for a mockup and given their name and email.

artwork_urls.description: Optional public HTTPS links to logo/design files

card_text.description: Exact text for the card (name, title, phone, email, website)

description.description: Design brief: business, style, colors, logo ideas, front/back layout

email.description: Where the mockup and video will be sent

name: request_free_mockup
title: Request a free mockup image and video
